rule: ruling:sam-2026-10-07 claims 8 and 11: the prototype wins by default and only a DR1 judgement or a real constraint overrides it; DR1's inc-145 was deferred, not judged (claims 3 and 6), so it overrides nothing, and within the top-ranked design source (prototype:dr2-1-source, above trace:prototype-dr2-1) the page that collects the answer defines it: label, hint ('The expected date of arrival at the port of entry') and stored field (arrivalDateAtPort) all say port of entry, so the review label 'Arrival date at destination' misdescribes the prototype's own data.
outcome: The arrival date is the expected arrival at the port of entry, as Design Release 2.1's arrival details page asks for it, hints it and stores it (arrivalDateAtPort). The question page, the review row and the out-of-window error message all read 'Arrival date at port of entry'; the prototype's review label 'Arrival date at destination' contradicts the data its own question collects and is not copied. The real service already does this, so nothing changes.
